title: Liver or gallbladder — carcinoma or sarcoma (cancer of liver, gallbladder, or bile ducts)
summary: Cancer of the liver, gallbladder, or bile ducts (intrahepatic or extrahepatic) — disabled per se under SSA Blue Book.

rule_json.criterion: Cancer of the liver (hepatocellular carcinoma), gallbladder, or bile ducts (intrahepatic or extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma) confirmed by pathology or characteristic imaging
